systems.country_label: electronic Civil Registration and Vital Statistics system
systems.owner: Ministry of Health, Registrar of Births and Deaths
systems.tiers: centralised; registration carried out locally by Ministry of Health staff at 258 health facilities and 79 civil registration centres

systems.owner: Ministry of Interior, Department of Immigration
systems.tiers: centralised; 6 fixed and 12 mobile Immigration Department enrolment centres

note: An identity-system diagnostic. Local Government Areas appear only as a count (8, with 43 districts) and as a code in the identification number; registration is done by ministry and Immigration Department staff, not by local governments. Nothing is stated about a local government office or its connection.
